title: The Cheap Phone
intro: You want a used Zephyr X5 phone. A seller on Tradely has one far below the usual price.
Tap anything that looks odd to sniff it closer. Pin what is suspicious, clear what is harmless.
When you are sure, decide what to do.

notify.text: Phone is yours, send the advance first…

screen.context: Listing: Zephyr X5, "like new". Usual price about ₹28,000.

msg: Hi! The Zephyr X5 is yours for
I am in another city, so I will ship it.
, not through the app, to save fees.

msg.text: Another buyer is ready. Confirm in 30 minutes.
Photos: the phone with its box and bill.

price.label: Price far below normal
price.lens: ₹8,000 for a phone that costs about ₹28,000.
price.why: A price far below normal is the bait.

advance.label: Advance before shipping
advance.why: Pay only when you hold the phone, or through a protected way.

phone.label: Pay outside the marketplace
phone.lens: He asks you to skip the app and pay his personal number.
phone.why: Leaving the marketplace removes every protection you had.

rush.label: Hurry or lose it
rush.lens: Confirm in 30 minutes or another buyer takes it.
rush.why: Rushing you is a pressure trick.

pics.label: Nice photos with a bill
pics.lens: A phone, its box and a bill.
pics.why: Photos and bills are copied from other ads. They prove nothing.

actions.label: Ask to meet and see the phone first

block_report.line: Reported the listing. The marketplace removed the seller before he fooled anyone else.

verify.line: The seller refused to meet and went quiet. A search found the same photos in other ads. Case cracked.

ignore.line: You stayed safe. But the same scam is still landing on other people.

go_ahead.line: The ₹3,000 went to a stranger. No phone came, and the number went dead.

what_if.go_ahead: Meeting the seller, paying only for the phone in your hand, or using the marketplace's own payment would have stopped it.
what_if.ignore: Reporting takes two taps and helps protect other people.
what_if.verify: Checking was smart. Reporting it as well helps protect other people.

golden_rule: Pay for a used item only when you hold it, or through the marketplace's own protected payment. Never an advance to a stranger.

quick_check.q: A seller offers a used phone at a third of its price and asks for an advance outside the app. What do you do?

options.text: Send the advance, the price is great
Only buy after seeing it, or by the marketplace's own protected payment

quick_check.explain: An advance to a stranger, outside the app, is the trap.

hints.nudge: How does he want to be paid, and when?

rows.v: Transfers, gift cards, crypto: you cannot get them back
